summary: On a macOS control node, Ansible can crash with an objc fork safety error and 'A worker was found in a dead state'; set OBJC_DISABLE_INITIALIZE_FORK_SAFETY=YES in your shell.
questions: Ansible on my Mac says 'A worker was found in a dead state', how do I fix it?
What is the objc_initializeAfterForkError crash with Ansible?

answer_card.title: Fix macOS 'worker found in a dead state'
answer_card.answer_md:
On macOS control nodes, the fork-safety error (`+[__NSCFConstantString initialize] may have been in progress...` followed by *A worker was found in a dead state*) is fixed by:

```bash
export OBJC_DISABLE_INITIALIZE_FORK_SAFETY=YES
```

Add it to your shell profile.
